BZ.name: Blue Bird Airways
BZ.how: Email bookings@bluebirdair.com at least 7 days before the flight with their sports equipment form (SSR-05). Without approval they can refuse the bike at check-in.

DE.name: Condor
DE.how: Register the bike online in My booking, up to 8 hours before departure. Cheaper online than at the airport. Bike must be packed.

OS.name: Austrian Airlines
OS.how: Registration by phone or email is mandatory and the bike is only guaranteed after they confirm. Fee depends on the route, plus a small service fee.

W6.name: Wizz Air
W6.how: Sports equipment is added on Wizz Air's own site. Confirm the current fee there before paying.
